channel.title: Scholarship Navigator: what changed
channel.description: Changes to the scholarships and the tool, newest first.

item.title: Version 3
item.description: A new design in the NSATS colours: a menu across the top, a home page that shows every part of the tool, and cards you can scan. Start with five quick questions. Your matches show straight away, and the rest of the questions are optional, to confirm the schemes marked "Check". Results now sit beside your answers, with tabs for scholarships, loans, internships, coaching, skills and company scholarships.

item.title: Version 2, release 12
item.description: How-to-apply guides for Odisha and Tamil Nadu checked against the official portals: Odisha now confirmed, with current deadlines; Tamil Nadu helplines added. Internships across India: 11 government internships and apprenticeship schemes, including the AICTE internship portal, NITI Aayog, MeitY, the Ministry of External Affairs, RBI, SEBI, ISRO and DRDO labs. A new page on free government skill training: PMKVY, DDU-GKY, rural self-employment institutes, Jan Shikshan Sansthan, PM Vishwakarma and ITIs. A new page on free coaching (the central scheme for SC and OBC students, and schemes in UP, Rajasthan and Delhi) and the lower exam fees for JEE Main, NEET, CUET, GATE and CLAT.

item.title: Version 2, release 11
item.description: College finder: 16,671 stand-alone institutions added (polytechnics, nursing, teacher-training, paramedical, PGDM, pharmacy and hotel-management institutes), from the Ministry of Education's list. The finder now covers 85,300 institutions. For each stand-alone institute it shows the national body whose approval its courses need. All 20 AIIMS were checked against the Ministry's list of them; all were already in the finder.

item.title: Version 2, release 10
item.description: The "See an example student" button was removed from the home page.

item.title: Version 2, release 9
item.description: How-to-apply guides for the 16 priority states: which portal, what to keep ready, the steps, what happens after you submit, and the helpline. Each guide says whether its steps were read on the official portal or come from listings. A guide to the National Scholarship Portal's one-time registration (OTR), which many states now ask for first.

item.title: Version 2, release 8
item.description: New look: the Campus Green theme, with the Anek typeface served from this site. A new first question asks what you are studying: Class 11 or 12, ITI, diploma, a degree or a postgraduate degree. Schemes are matched to your level. Added: post-matric scholarship for students with disabilities, the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (Class 11 and 12 renewals) and the AICTE postgraduate scholarship (GATE, GPAT, CEED). AICTE Pragati and Saksham now show for diploma students too. The minority scholarships of the Ministry of Minority Affairs are listed as closed to new students, as the ministry told Parliament.

item.title: Version 2, release 7
item.description: 11 central schemes added: post-matric scholarships for SC, ST and OBC students, Top Class (SC), AICTE Pragati, Saksham, Swanath and Sarswati, the J&K and Ladakh special scholarship, INSPIRE and the PM's scholarship for wards of ex-servicemen. Each scheme now shows whether applications are open, opening soon or closed, with the days left. A new "Open now" filter shows only open schemes. Each scheme shows the date it was last checked and what changed in its entry. A page on paid internships and apprenticeships (PM Internship Scheme, NATS, NAPS). A page on spotting fake scholarships, with questions to ask your own college about its scholarships. A page for every scheme and every state, and a browse page by category, state and course. This change log, also as an RSS feed.

item.title: Version 2, release 6
item.description: College finder: 68,691 universities, colleges and ITIs from official lists, with ITI grades. Cheapest education loans from public-sector banks and five state loan schemes. 38 company, public-sector and trust scholarships. Every source we use is listed on the Our data page.

item.title: State schemes checked on official portals
item.description: Each state scheme was checked against official government pages and marked confirmed, partly confirmed, not confirmed or not found.
